title: Robotics Senior Motion Planning Engineer
desc:
We are the catalyst for the industrial world’s digital transformation.
For more than 35 years, ground breaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens
Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey.
We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers.
We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries.
What are my responsibilities?
Design and develop collision detection and avoidance capabilities for robotic motion planning
Develop and optimize redundancy resolution strategies for complex robotic systems
Implement singularity detection, avoidance, and recovery mechanisms
Design and enhance trajectory generation and optimization algorithms
Evaluate motion trajectory smoothness, continuity, and feasibility requirements
Define, select, and validate kinematic solution strategies and motion execution options
What do I need to qualify for this job?
BSc., MSc., or PhD. in Mechatronics Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering/Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Proven track record with 5+ years of professional software development experience
Strong experience in robotics and motion planning algorithms, including sampling-based planning, optimization-based planning, trajectory generation, collision detection, swept-volume analysis, and motion feasibility assessment
Experience in robot kinematics, inverse kinematics, redundancy resolution, null-space control, singularity analysis and avoidance, and joint and Cartesian motion constraints
Experience in real-time and reactive motion planning, predictive control techniques, dynamic environment modeling, and high-performance computing for robotics applications
Strong experience with C++ software development, performance optimization, multi-threaded systems, benchmarking, profiling, and robotics software frameworks and libraries
Experience with robotics middleware and motion planning frameworks such as MoveIt, OMPL, ROS/ROS 2, Pinocchio, Drake, or comparable technologies
Experience with robotic simulation and digital validation environments, including physics-based verification of motion planning solutions using tools such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo, or similar platforms
Familiarity with modern GPU-accelerated computing technologies and scalable software architectures for robotics applications is a plus
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams
Knowledge of and experience with Scrum and Agile development methodologies is an advantage
Very good command of English
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder communication skills
No restriction for travelling abroad
